training: One team-trained model: assets/trl_head.joblib, a scikit-learn LogisticRegression (C=1.0, classes TRL 4-9) that maps the 12 per-criterion best probabilities produced by this package (rules + bge-base search + bge-reranker + deberta NLI) to a TRL. Trained and cross-checked on the APCTT public sample cases (USGS reports) whose PDFs the team ran through the package, using the organizer's estimated TRL as the label (not expert labels). Training code: calibrate.py (team tool, not shipped; commands labels, collect, fit). Hardware: team RTX laptop GPU for feature collection; the fit itself runs on CPU. assets/calibration.json holds the acceptance thresholds and TRL settings chosen on the same cases. No external or hidden data, no catalogue weights modified. Head inputs for this version: per-criterion probabilities plus word-frequency features of the report text (list in participant_module/headfeat.py); model: ridge regression rounded to TRL 4-9.

data_sources.source: APCTT public sample cases (contracts/public-cases.json, USGS reports)
data_sources.role: checking and tuning the rules and thresholds
data_sources.label_origin: organizer's estimated TRL per report; not expert labels
data_sources.license: U.S. public domain (USGS); some figures third-party, see the manifest's licence_note

weights: assets/calibration.json (thresholds and TRL-head settings, not a model)
dependency_declarations: the common base environment (base_id in submission.json)
catalogue models bge-base-en-v1.5, bge-reranker-v2-m3, deberta-v3-large-zeroshot-v2.0-c (submission.json models[])

notes: Regex rules plus catalogue embedding search (hypothesis plus short queries per criterion), reranker and NLI verification; a criterion is met when a verbatim sentence passes the NLI threshold in assets/calibration.json (or a rule hit with minimal NLI support). TRL comes from the team-trained head over the 12 criterion probabilities (strongly shaped by the public cases' TRL distribution, mostly TRL 5-7); the package abstains with 'insufficient evidence' when no TRL-rung criterion (C01-C09) reaches even weak support. The rule ladder in trl.py is the fallback if the head cannot load.
